idea-plugin.name: Git Rebase and Push Assistant
idea-plugin.description:
Git Rebase and Push Assistant

Streamline your Git workflow with one-click automation for rebase, commit, and push operations.

✨ Key Features

  • Smart Rebase & Push - Automated fetch → rebase → force-push with lease workflow
  • AI Commit Messages - Generate conventional commit messages using OpenAI API (supports custom endpoints)
  • GitLab Integration - Auto-create merge requests after push with secure token storage
  • Arthas Hotfix Generator - Generate Base64-encoded hot-patching scripts for Java classes
  • Safe Force Push - Uses --force-with-lease to prevent overwriting others' work
  • Real-time Progress - Unified dialog with inline progress display
  • Full i18n Support - Complete English and Chinese localization

🚀 Quick Start

  1. Configure OpenAI API in Settings → Tools → Git Rebase & Push
  2. In Git commit dialog, click "变基并提交推送" action
  3. Select target branch and let AI generate your commit message
  4. Optionally enable auto-MR creation

🔧 System Requirements

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2025.3.5+
  • JDK 17+

Git 变基推送助手

一键自动化 Git 变基、提交和推送操作，提升开发效率。

✨ 核心功能

  • 智能变基与推送 - 自动化 fetch → rebase → force-push 全流程
  • AI 提交消息 - 使用 OpenAI API 生成规范提交消息（支持自定义端点）
  • GitLab 集成 - 推送后自动创建 Merge Request，Token 安全存储
  • Arthas 热修复 - 为 Java 类生成 Base64 编码的热修复脚本
  • 安全强制推送 - 使用 --force-with-lease 防止覆盖他人提交
  • 实时进度显示 - 统一对话框展示操作进度
  • 完整国际化 - 完整的中英文界面支持

🚀 快速开始

  1. 在 Settings → Tools → Git Rebase & Push 配置 OpenAI API
  2. 在 Git 提交对话框点击 "变基并提交推送" 操作
  3. 选择目标分支，让 AI 生成提交消息
  4. 可选启用自动创建 MR

🔧 系统要求

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2025.3.5+
  • JDK 17+
